title: Yosemite: One of America’s Most Famous National Parks (1/2)
titleZh: 優勝美地：美國最著名的國家公園之一 (1/2)
summaryZh: 介紹加州優勝美地國家公園的瀑布、巨杉、野生動物與公園的歷史。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — America's National Parks

sentences.text: Yosemite National Park is one of the most famous parks in the United States.
sentences.zh: 優勝美地國家公園是美國最有名的公園之一。

sentences.text: It has high waterfalls, huge trees, wild animals, and beautiful rivers.
sentences.zh: 這裡有高聳的瀑布、巨大的樹木、野生動物和美麗的河流。

sentences.text: Yosemite is in the Sierra Nevada Mountains in California.
sentences.zh: 優勝美地位在加州的內華達山脈。

sentences.text: It has valleys formed by ancient ice that cut deep into the earth millions of years ago.
sentences.zh: 園內的山谷，是幾百萬年前古老的冰河深深切割大地所形成的。

sentences.text: Water from high in the mountains falls in many places to the Green Valley far below.
sentences.zh: 水從高山上的許多地方傾瀉而下，落入下方遠處的綠色山谷。

sentences.text: One of these waterfalls, Yosemite Falls, is the fifth highest on earth.
sentences.zh: 其中的優勝美地瀑布是全世界第五高的瀑布。

sentences.text: In Yosemite's Mariposa Grove, visitors can see some of the tallest and oldest trees on earth, giant sequoia.
sentences.zh: 在優勝美地的馬里波薩林區，遊客可以看到地球上最高、最古老的樹木之一：巨杉。

sentences.text: One of them, known as the Grizzly Giant, is estimated to be almost 3,000 years old.
sentences.zh: 其中一棵叫做「灰熊巨人」，據估計已經將近三千歲了。

sentences.text: In 1864, President Abraham Lincoln signed a bill that made Yosemite a state park of California.
sentences.zh: 1864 年，林肯總統簽署法案，讓優勝美地成為加州的州立公園。

sentences.text: It was named a national park in 1890. There are several beautiful old hotels in Yosemite, as well as other housing for visitors.
sentences.zh: 它在 1890 年被指定為國家公園。優勝美地裡有幾間漂亮的老飯店，也有其他提供遊客住宿的地方。

sentences.text: People can also camp in the park.
sentences.zh: 遊客也可以在園區裡露營。

sentences.text: More than 60 kinds of animals live in Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 有超過六十種動物住在優勝美地。

sentences.text: Black bears, coyotes, and mountain lions also live in Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 黑熊、郊狼和美洲獅也棲息在優勝美地。

sentences.text: People come from all over the world to climb the park's huge rock formations.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的人都來這裡攀爬園內巨大的岩壁。
